programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: Feeling bad about his ninja past, Teeny Weeny tries to help defeat the ninjas using his monster powers.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When Tracker falls into sinkhole, he meets several creatures in the underground tunnels that need rescuing. But while waiting for Ryla's assistance, he's forced to take the lead to keep the animals safe from the rising water.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!

programme.title: Mixmups
programme.desc: The Mixmups go on a racing car adventure to win a race. But when Pockets beats Spin and Giggle, will they find another way so that they can all be winners?

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa and Suzy learn that grown-ups must work all day, and the children play at working in a shop at playgroup and find it very hard work.

programme.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programme.desc: Evie and Tsehay are in the Wiggly Kitchen playing, 'name that kitchen sound'. They come across some hay and they don't know what to do with it, the Dancing Water Police of Wiggle Town will know what to do.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep
